decision: The repair was authorised and carried out, but the ticket was closed by the system (event-032) with three definition-of-done items unmet: no invoice on file (event-030), no invoice forwarded to the landlord, and landlord confirmation still outstanding (event-031). I did not re-close the request. I chased the instructed provider (Oakfield Homes) for the invoice and a completion report, asked the landlord to confirm completion, and asked the tenant to confirm the appliance now runs a full cycle. Case left at final checks, waiting on those three named parties. No liability decision taken (PRO-TENANT-LIABILITY); contractor-name inconsistencies recorded as data quality, not acted on.
recap: Dishwasher repair authorised at £95 inc VAT and done; closed prematurely with invoice and landlord confirmation missing, so I chased provider, landlord and tenant.

facts.statement: Tenant Amelia Nolan reported the dishwasher at Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 1ZZ fills and washes but never ends its cycle; started recently; two guinea pigs at the property.
Intake classified the issue as Appliances / dishwasher not completing cycle, severity ROUTINE, with a containment step (photograph the appliance and any error lights) shown to the tenant.
The landlord was asked on 29/11/2026 whether to instruct a contractor and replied 'Yes please go ahead' on 03/12/2026.
Provider Oakfield Homes was assigned and briefed on 06/12/2026; the tenant was told who was attending.
A visit was agreed with the tenant for the following morning (call of 06/12/2026) and the contractor attended on 07/12/2026.

Provider report 07/12/2026: water in the base removed, loose connection on the flow-through heater tightened and retested, appliance running as it should; a replacement dial is required (missing). Quote £95 including parts, labour and VAT, variable if extra parts are needed.
The quote was sent to the landlord on 07/12/2026 and the landlord replied 'Please go ahead' the same day; the contractor was instructed to proceed.
A further appointment was arranged with the tenant for the next day between 12 and 5 to fit the replacement knob (untrusted call transcript, 09/12/2026).
On 13/12/2026 the system moved the task to Result and marked it completed; no provider completion report or photographs appear after the repair visit.
Document upload was skipped with the reason 'Invoice uploaded. The invoice is unavailable' — no invoice is on file and none is evidenced as forwarded to the landlord.
The system recorded 'Need confirmation from landlord' at 05:44 on 13/12/2026 and then 'All checks have been completed; the request is now closed' one minute later, with no landlord reply in between.
No landlord spend cap or standing instruction record is available in this case; authority for the spend rests on the landlord's own messages.

conflicts.description: Provider identity is inconsistent across records: the agency assigned and briefed Oakfield Homes, while untrusted call transcripts name 'Cedar Maintenance' and 'Alder Maintenance', the intake summary refers to a 'Riverside Services dishwasher', and the provider report is addressed to 'Juniper Surveying'.
conflicts.resolution: The agency's own assignment record (event-011/event-013) governs: all chases sent to Oakfield Homes at the address on the agency record. The other names come from untrusted transcripts/summaries and are recorded as data quality, not as a change of provider.

conflicts.description: The system closed the request as 'all checks completed' while its own preceding line said landlord confirmation was still needed and the invoice was unavailable.
conflicts.resolution: Treated the closure as premature: ticket kept at final_checks, outstanding items chased with the provider and landlord. No re-closure attempted.

red_flags.description: Four different provider/company names across the artefacts for one job (Oakfield Homes, Cedar Maintenance, Alder Maintenance, Juniper Surveying; plus 'Riverside Services' in the intake summary), and two notes whose text is absent from the record.
red_flags.action_taken: Recorded in the case note (ACT-4); acted only on the agency's own assignment record (Oakfield Homes).
